elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: The added clause applies upon expiry or termination of the Agreement or any Order Form and requires Vendor, at Customer's request, to provide transition assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The added clause expressly provides for transition assistance “for up to six months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The added clause expressly states that transition assistance is provided “at Vendor's then-current rates.”

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must return Customer Data within 30 days.
elements.evidence: The added clause requires Vendor, within thirty days after expiry or termination, to return all Customer Data.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The added clause expressly requires return in “a standard machine-readable format.”

elements.element: After returning Customer Data, Vendor must delete it from its systems.
elements.evidence: Clause (c) requires Vendor, after the return, to delete Customer Data from its systems.

elements.element: Vendor must certify the deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: Clause (c) requires Vendor to certify the deletion to Customer in writing after the data return.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: The added clause requires transition assistance upon expiry or termination at Customer's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: Assistance available for up to six months encompasses the fallback period of 90 days.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must export or return Customer Data.
elements.evidence: The added clause requires Vendor to return all Customer Data after expiry or termination.

elements.element: The Customer Data export must occur within 30 days.
elements.evidence: The added clause expressly imposes a thirty-day deadline.

result.reason: The operative addition fully implements the preferred position and therefore also exceeds the fallback. It adds only transition assistance, data return, deletion, and certification terms responsive to the requested position, without altering unrelated commercial provisions. Drafting is clear, although a specific deadline for deletion and certification after return would improve enforceability.
